query: SELECT Trim( hl.region ) AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no) AS population FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.is_in_population = true AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala) AND Trim( hl.region ) IS NOT NULL AND Trim( hl.region ) != '' GROUP BY Trim( hl.region ) ORDER BY population DESC LIMIT 1200
